title: The Surplus
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office discovers a $4300 budget surplus that must be spent by the end of the day or lost. The staff debates how to best use the funds, with options including a new copier, new chairs, and other improvements, leading to disagreements among key characters like Jim and Pam. Meanwhile, Dwight reveals he and Angela are legally married, causing tension. Michael struggles with the decision, considering keeping a personal bonus from the savings, but ultimately delegates the choice to the office, who decide on new chairs. The episode ends with unresolved questions about the final outcomes of some conflicts and relationships.
